entries.title: Surefire fork exceeds the container memory limit
entries.root_cause: The BatchReconcileTest fork is killed after the container reaches its memory limit. Reduce its memory use or raise the job's memory limit.

entries.title: Java compilation cannot resolve a method
entries.root_cause: The production code calls a method that does not exist on the current LedgerSpan type. Correct the call or provide the method.

entries.title: Fork exit status assertion fails
entries.root_cause: WorkerExitTest expects exit status 137 but receives 0. Resolve the mismatch between the reported exit status and the test expectation.
entries.differs_from_earlier: The same exit status appears in a JUnit assertion, while the Surefire fork remains alive and reports the test result; it is not a container kill.

entries.title: Surefire fork is killed at the memory limit again
entries.root_cause: The BatchReconcileTest fork is killed after the container reaches its memory limit. Reduce its memory use or raise the job's memory limit.
entries.differs_from_earlier: A later run passes another test first and has different run metadata and memory event counts, but the same test fork again dies at the container limit with exit code 137.
